name: Transition-zone resets
summary: From the middle of the court, reset fed balls at the feet softly into the non-volley zone, then step in; count resets that land in the zone.
setup: Player stands in the middle of the court, between the baseline and the non-volley-zone line; feeder at the opposite non-volley-zone line in the same half
Feeder pats low balls that land at the player's feet, one at a time, at a cooperative pace
Player resets each ball softly into the non-volley zone after one bounce, then takes two steps in and walks back
Sets of 20 feeds; swap roles after each set; count resets that land in the zone
success_criterion: In each of 2 sets of 20 feeds, at least 12 resets land in the non-volley zone
coach_rationale: (judgment) Balls at the feet in the middle of the court are a common source of errors under pressure (AN-07 forced-error share); a soft reset is the answer, and cooperative feeds let a beginner groove it before live play. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
